originality.rationale: Exact same-model 2022 and 2026 primary full texts and 2021 deterministic precursor were materially inspected. Both finite formulas and the deterministic cusp are explicitly excluded as prior; 2016 SECA184 already illustrates square-root current for a different one-density rule. published-finding corpus and accessible ledger claims have no observed same-object two-density positive-noise thermodynamic flux/crossover. residual_risks: The exact thermodynamic result is a nontrivial asymptotic consequence of the published finite partition expression, not an independent model.
A general earlier closed transport formula or equivalence-of-ensembles theorem may yield the same specialization without indexing by this model or parameters.
No independent peer verification or exhaustive global publication search has been performed.

value.rationale: This natural stochastic many-particle transport problem has two conserved densities and a deterministic crease. The exact macroscopic current eliminates a finite double sum, proves strict noise enhancement, and quantifies the singular critical smoothing with a density-dependent square-root coefficient and a full crossover function. These locate the physically meaningful rounding of competing transport branches and are not merely small numerical improvements or arbitrary slices.
